dict.string: Coda records your voice so it can transcribe meetings and voice commands on this device. Audio never leaves your machine.
Coda turns a spoken command into text so the local agent can run it.
Coda talks to Mail, Calendar, Reminders, and Music on this Mac only after you approve the action.
Coda captures meeting audio from other participants, and a screen image only when you ask what is on your screen. Nothing is uploaded.
